arn.text: Istini Ayesh ni Hata Kan survives the Fall of Oneah by hiding beneath the Roof of Lights when goblins breach Xa-On.
She travels with Captain Raal telling stories of Oneah, until Raal leaves her on Stahaan, where she becomes involved in the Mirtiin Rebellion.
Ayesh is captured and then freed by Zhanrax alongside Tlik, and she later reunites with Raal, and they marry.
